connector.name: AXIS Toolbox - Agentic Commerce Codebase Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Generate AGENTS.md, AP2 compliance docs, checkout rules, debug playbook & MCP configs from any repo.
connector.summary: Hosted at axis-api-6c7z.onrender.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lastmanupinc-hub account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api_key>. Get a free API key at https://axis-api-6c7z.onrender.com. Required for analyze_repo, analyze_files, and prepare_for_agentic_purchasing. list_programs and search_and_discover_tools work without auth.
